settings.title: Clear prices
settings.subtitle: Per day, per week, no surprises
settings.text: Longer rentals get cheaper automatically. Deposits and extras are shown before you book, never after.

settings.title: Ready at pickup
settings.subtitle: Checked, cleaned and charged
settings.text: Show the code from your confirmation at the counter and you are on your way. Returning is just as quick.

settings.question: Can I change my dates?
settings.answer: Yes. Ask from your booking page and we confirm the new dates by email if the items are still free.

settings.question: What if something breaks?
settings.answer: Tell us when you return it. Normal wear is on us; damage is charged at repair cost, with photos.
